notes.title: Global update for TRUEM v1.0.6
notes.content:
[b]Global update for TRUEM from Holgear Games![/b]

Racers, meet one of the most significant updates for TRUEM! We continue to develop the game and make it even more exciting. This time you will not only find many changes, but also new mechanics that will lay the foundation for future updates!

[b]New cars - more speed, more drive![/b]

This time, the TRUEM garage has been replenished with three new cars, each of which will give you a unique experience:
Hypercar - unrivaled power and incredible speed.
Sports car - the perfect combination of control and dynamics.
Sports car from the 40s - feel the spirit of classic racing!

[b] Track update - a new level of realism[/b]

Spore Raceway - a small section of the track has been changed.
Adanta Raceway & Spore Raceway – new objects have been added to create the atmosphere of real racing competitions.

[b]Free Races – now with full control![/b]

Now in free race mode you can track:
Number of completed laps.
Best time on the track.
Off-track zones have been added – if you go beyond the track, your lap will not be counted. Race cleanly and accurately!

[b]New challenges in career mode![/b]

Now before the start of the race you need to wait for the traffic light signal. This is not just a stylish feature, but also a test of your reaction, which can be a decisive factor in the race!

[b]Updated design of the main menu[/b]

Now it has become darker, modern and minimalistic. Ease of navigation, style and convenience – everything for maximum immersion in the world of racing!

[b]New Special Race Mode – Test Your Skills![/b]

Test yourself in extreme conditions:
Total darkness – rely only on your instincts and knowledge of the track.
Limited fuel – be economical and count every liter!
Manual transmission – feel like a real professional!

[b]What's next?[/b]

This update is an important step in the development of TRUEM. In the next versions, we will:
Add new mechanics for drift levels.
Improve the graphics to make the rides even more exciting.

Are you ready to try out the new features of TRUEM? Update and conquer the tracks right now!

notes.title: New Truem update
notes.content:
In the new Truem v1.0.5 (v1.0.57) update, we have added a lot of new and interesting content.

A new racing track designed for drifting has been added. The track is made in a winter style. Absolutely every car in the game will change its behavior on this track. Here you can test your skills in controlled drifting.

Also, clouds have been added in this update. Now the Truem game worlds look even more saturated and natural.

New car. We have added a car made in a classic Japanese style. The car has rear-wheel drive. This is the first car in Truem with permanent rear-wheel drive.

New game mechanics. We have added a new drift points counter. It works on the same principle that you could see in other games.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160090/e847b0eed4467853adb130776d50f7314d712280.png[/img]

Buy Truem and enter the atmosphere of racing at maximum speed!

notes.title: New truem update!
notes.content:
Cars, levels, updated menu and much more!

A new car has been added, and the appearance of one of the current cars has been updated.

A mini map has been added. Now it is even more comfortable to move around the expanses of truem. The map is made in a thematic style.

New career levels have been added in the qualification mode.

New objects have been added to the Spore and Adanta maps. Now the maps have become more lively.

The main menu has also undergone changes. Now in the settings selection panel you can see in real time how the quality of the game changes, depending on the settings. The selection of free runs has also been redesigned. Now, the background of the map and car selection has become more dynamic and relevant. It is also possible to return from the list of cars to the list of maps, if necessary.

Go to truem and see everything with your own eyes!

notes.title: New race track in TRUEM!
notes.content: In the new update, we have added a new race track "Spore raceway" where you can test your driving skills! This race track has a difficult terrain. Lots of hills, so hold on to the steering wheel tightly!
